data.content:
Brian White has 17 goals and two assists for Vancouver. Oliver Larraz has one goal and five assists, and Mathias Laborda has four goals and two assists. Tristan Blackmon is suspended due to a red card, Sam Adekugbe is sidelined with a muscle injury, and Cabrera Kenji is out with a foot injury. Additionally, Vancouver will be without Thomas Muller, who has nine goals and six assists this season, due to a muscle injury.

## Key Numbers [...] St. Louis City won 3-1 away earlier this season, marking the most recent of the five meetings between the two teams. St. Louis City holds a record of one win, one draw, and three losses across those matches. These encounters have produced an average of 4.2 goals per meeting. Vancouver Whitecaps were unbeaten in their last two meetings away at St. Louis City, a run of one win and one draw.

## Key Players to Watch and Missing Players [...] St. Louis City sit second in the Western Conference with 50 points. In their last league match, the team won 6-2 at home against Los Angeles Galaxy. They have four wins and one draw in their last five matches, and the team is currently on an 18-match unbeaten run.
